findings.claim: The landmark_00_local_dx coordinate proxy is non-monotone over the full observed window [0.0,0.49]: it rises from near zero to a positive peak around t≈0.10-0.11, then falls to a negative trough around t≈0.18-0.19, and returns toward small positive values by the window end.

The endpoint contrast is weak relative to the interior excursion: whole-window z is -0.18 while the first-node rate z is -17.5 and the last-node rate z is +8.1, indicating the strongest temporal structure is in the rate of change rather than a large net displacement.

The observed-node linear fit is not accepted (polynomial_accepted=false, relative_node_RMSE≈0.78) and the series shows 6 sign changes with 9 strong sign conflicts across 14 independent batches, so a single stationary target or monotone trend is not supported for this coordinate.
The learning window and observed score times span [0.0,0.5] with 50 observed score nodes, and the curve support audit reports [0.0,0.49]; no extrapolation beyond the observed support is allowed.

hypotheses.direction: increase toward the observed early positive peak
hypotheses.falsifier: The early-window mean of landmark_00_local_dx does not increase relative to the incumbent when the early dose is raised, or the late-window trough deepens without a corresponding early gain.
hypotheses.statement: If the landmark_00_local_dx coordinate is controlled, the reward should target the early-window positive excursion (approximately t≈0.10-0.11) rather than a whole-window mean, because the observed curve peaks there before reversing sign.

hypotheses.direction: reduce the depth of the negative trough
hypotheses.falsifier: The mid/late-window minimum of landmark_00_local_dx is unchanged or worsens when the mid/late dose is raised, or the early peak is lost.
hypotheses.statement: If the landmark_00_local_dx coordinate is controlled, the late-window negative trough (approximately t≈0.18-0.19) should be treated as a distinct regime from the early peak, because the curve changes sign 6 times and the first/last rate z-scores have opposite signs.

limitations: Only one coordinate proxy (landmark_00_local_dx) was read; the remaining 199 curve features were not inspected, so cross-coordinate consistency is unverified.
Stage profiles and temporal profiles are unavailable; no stage boundary or phase knot is supported by the delivered evidence.
The curve is a predicted-endpoint world-coordinate feature, not a measured affinity or energy; no chemical-interaction interpretation is warranted.
Selection preference and descendant survival are not distinguished in the delivered evidence; the observed curve is association evidence only, not measured final benefit.
No decoded final affinity labels were delivered; missing labels are unobserved, not failures or high-affinity evidence.
